tools.name: get_institution_holdings
tools.description: Get current stock holdings of an institutional investor (hedge fund, mutual fund, pension fund) from their latest SEC 13F filing. Returns top positions with share counts, values, and quarter-over-quarter changes.

params.name: institution
params.description: Institution CIK number (e.g. '1067983'), slug (e.g. 'berkshire-hathaway'), or name (e.g. 'Berkshire Hathaway') — names are resolved automatically.

tools.name: list_institutions
tools.description: List top institutional investors (hedge funds, mutual funds, etc.) tracked in the SEC 13F database. Supports search by name and pagination.

params.name: search
params.description: Search by institution or founder name

tools.name: get_stock_profile
tools.description: Get a company's profile — sector, market cap, price, P/E ratio, 52-week range, beta, dividend yield, and other key financials.

tools.name: get_stock_holders
tools.description: Get top institutional holders of a stock from SEC 13F filings. Shows which hedge funds, mutual funds, and pension funds own the most shares, with quarter-over-quarter changes.

tools.name: get_stock_activity
tools.description: Get institutional buying/selling activity trend for a stock over multiple quarters. Shows how many institutions are buying vs selling, net share changes, and value flows — useful for detecting accumulation or distribution patterns.

params.name: quarters
params.description: Number of quarters to return (default 8 = 2 years)

tools.name: get_stock_price
tools.description: Get historical daily stock prices (OHLC). Returns a summary by default; set series=true to get the full daily price series (for backtesting / charting).

params.name: limit
params.description: Max rows of the daily series to return when series=true.

params.name: series
params.description: If true, return the full daily OHLC series (up to `limit` rows) instead of just a summary.

tools.name: get_insider_trades
tools.description: Get insider/executive stock trades (SEC Form 4) for a company. Shows CEO, CFO, directors, and other officers buying or selling their own company's stock — a key signal for institutional investors.

params.name: executive_cik
params.description: Filter by specific executive CIK (from list_insider_traders)

tools.name: list_insider_traders
tools.description: List executives/insiders who have recently traded their company stock. Filter by role (CEO only or all executives). Useful for finding notable insider buying/selling activity across the market.

params.name: role
params.description: Filter by role (case-insensitive): CEO, executive/officer, or all

tools.name: get_congress_trades
tools.description: Get stock trades made by U.S. Congress members (House & Senate). Data sourced from mandatory financial disclosures. Filter by chamber, party, state, date range, or specific stock ticker.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order — volume (most traded value), trades (most trades), recent (latest first)

params.name: party
params.description: Filter by party — D=Democrat, R=Republican, I=Independent

tools.name: get_congress_member
tools.description: Get detailed trading history of a specific U.S. Congress member. Shows individual trades with transaction types, amounts, and disclosure dates.

params.name: member
params.description: Member slug (e.g. 'nancy-pelosi', 'dan-crenshaw'). Use get_congress_trades or search to find exact slugs.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search across institutions, stocks, and insider traders in the ko.io SEC database. Use this first when you have a name but need the CIK number, ticker, or slug to use with other tools.

params.name: query
params.description: Search query — company name, ticker, person name, or institution name (min 2 characters)

tools.name: get_form144_notices
tools.description: Get SEC Form 144 filings — notices of proposed sale of restricted/controlled securities by insiders. Filed before selling, these signal upcoming insider sales. Complements Form 4 (post-trade) with pre-trade intent.

tools.name: sec_list_filings
tools.description: List an entity's SEC filings from EDGAR (most recent first), each with its accession number. Provide the company's CIK (use search or get_stock_profile to find it). Returns accession numbers to pass to sec_get_filing_index / sec_get_filing_document.

tools.name: sec_get_filing_index
tools.description: Enumerate every file in a single SEC filing (primary document, exhibits, images, XBRL, the full .txt submission). Pass a file name from here to sec_get_filing_document.

tools.name: sec_get_filing_document
tools.description: Get a source document from a SEC filing, served by ko.io. Returns a ko.io LINK to the rendered document (open in a browser) plus, optionally, an extracted text excerpt. Never returns the whole file — for full content, open the link or request a specific section.

params.name: file
params.description: File name within the filing (from sec_get_filing_index). Omit for the primary document.

params.name: include_excerpt
params.description: Include a text excerpt (first ~6000 chars) in the response

tools.name: get_stock_financials
tools.description: Get quarterly or annual financial statements for a company (revenue, net income, EPS, margins, cash flow, debt ratios) from SEC 10-K/10-Q filings.

tools.name: get_treasury_yields
tools.description: Get U.S. Treasury yield curve data — daily yields for maturities from 1-month to 30-year. Essential for understanding interest rate environment and yield curve shape.

tools.name: get_fed_rates
tools.description: Get Federal Reserve interest rates — Fed Funds Rate, SOFR, Prime Rate, Discount Rate, and Treasury yields. Key indicators for monetary policy.

tools.name: get_economic_indicators
tools.description: Get U.S. economic indicators from BLS — CPI (inflation), PPI (producer prices), Non-farm Payrolls (employment), Unemployment Rate, JOLTS. Filter by category.

params.name: category
params.description: Category (case-insensitive): cpi/inflation, ppi, nfp/payrolls, unemployment, jolts, or all

tools.name: get_ftd_data
tools.description: Get SEC Failures-to-Deliver (FTD) data for a stock. High FTD quantities may indicate naked short selling or settlement issues.

tools.name: get_financial_stress
tools.description: Get the OFR Financial Stress Index — a daily indicator of stress in global financial markets. Values above 0 indicate above-average stress.

tools.name: get_crypto_exposure
tools.description: Get a market-wide summary of institutional exposure to US spot crypto ETFs (Bitcoin ETF complex: IBIT, FBTC, GBTC, etc.) from the latest quarter of SEC 13F filings. Returns total institutional USD held, quarter-over-quarter change, and a per-ETF breakdown (holders, USD, QoQ).

tools.name: get_crypto_holders
tools.description: List institutional investors holding US spot crypto ETFs (Bitcoin ETF complex), ranked by total USD held, from the latest quarter of SEC 13F filings. Optionally filter to holders of a specific ETF via the `product` parameter (e.g. 'IBIT').

params.name: product
params.description: Filter to holders of a specific spot crypto ETF ticker, e.g. 'IBIT', 'FBTC', 'GBTC'.

tools.name: get_crypto_holder
tools.description: Get one institution's spot crypto-ETF holdings (Bitcoin ETF complex): its per-ETF positions in the latest filed quarter (shares, USD, QoQ change, action) plus its rank among all crypto-ETF holders. Use a CIK number (find it with get_crypto_holders or the search tool).

params.name: institution
params.description: Institution CIK number (e.g. '1512857' for Brevan Howard) or name (e.g. 'BlackRock').
